name: GDI-Bench
description: A benchmark for evaluating text-to-image generative models (diffusion/generative image models) on prompt fidelity, visual quality, and alignment with text prompts. It provides prompts and reference evaluations (often human or automated metrics) to compare model outputs across aesthetic and semantic criteria.
evaluation_method: human_eval (preference/quality) and automated metrics such as FID or CLIP-score
reputation: Emerging / specialized benchmark with modest adoption for assessing text-to-image generation quality.
